svg.title: FFmpegLab demo: from marketplace template to AI-edited FFmpeg pull request
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough. 1) Browse the Render Marketplace and pick a template. 2) Copy Project. 3) Replace Media to swap in your own footage. 4) Comment on the timeline. 5) The coding agent rewrites render.sh and renders a preview. 6) Approve and merge the pull request.

g.text: Browse the Render Marketplace and pick a template
Copy Project — fork the render into your workspace
Replace Media — swap the template's clips for your own footage
Comment on the timeline where something needs to change
The coding agent rewrites render.sh and renders a preview
Approve the preview — the agent opens a pull request
